description: Distilled generic HLS flash pack. Kernel-independent. Not the 90-skill dump. No PE_BLK, no 64x64 GEMM ping-pong, not AutoSA.

skills.pattern: hot loop has no PIPELINE, or PIPELINE sits on a parent that still has a sequential child
skills.strategy: PIPELINE II=1 the true hot loop after inner independent loops are UNROLL. If Final II>1, fix addresses and recurrences first; do not leave II>1.
required_steps: identify the loop that dominates latency
UNROLL independent inner loops, then PIPELINE the remaining trip
do not PIPELINE a nest that still has a non-unrolled child
guards: pragma-only PIPELINE on a carried FP add stays II=4
this pack does not set PE_BLK

skills.pattern: UNROLL without matching ARRAY_PARTITION, so ports serialize
skills.strategy: Partition local arrays to the parallel accesses. Never partition top m_axi ports. Do not complete-partition huge buffers.
required_steps: ARRAY_PARTITION cyclic or complete only on locals that the UNROLL actually touches
if util explodes, drop complete and use cyclic factor equal to the unroll
never ARRAY_PARTITION the top INTERFACE arrays
guards: complete-partition of a large DRAM-sized array is illegal
this is not a 64x64 GEMM rule

skills.pattern: independent arrays share bundle=gmem, or load/store walks one element per cycle
skills.strategy: Distinct bundles per independent array. max_widen_bitwidth=512. LANES = 512 / element_bits. Burst 64, outstanding 16. Keep the header pointer types.
required_steps: m_axi each independent array on its own bundle
load/store inner loop steps by LANES with UNROLL
do not change top pointer types to ap_uint<512>
guards: LANES is AXI packing, not a PE count

skills.pattern: compute still reads m_axi on every trip even though the working set fits on-chip
skills.strategy: If the kernel working set fits, copy into locals, compute locally, store once. Compute never touches m_axi.
required_steps: estimate bytes at compile-time sizes
if they fit, stage fully before compute
if they do not fit, tile; do not complete-partition the full DRAM arrays
guards: fits is a size check, not a 64x64 assumption
this pack is not a systolic PE array

skills.pattern: output += ... or other RMW directly on an m_axi array inside a pipelined loop
skills.strategy: Accumulate in a local, write DRAM once. Gold from zero means skip load of the output when the spec is write-only.
required_steps: no m_axi read-modify-write in the hot loop
local acc then one store stream
keep the kernel.h top name and ranks
guards: DEPENDENCE inter false is not a substitute for removing RMW

skills.pattern: linearized g with shifts/masks so HLS cannot prove write-once and holds Final II=4
skills.strategy: Nested affine indices. Assign the local output once. No old=local; local=old+dot.
required_steps: use row and column loops, not a linearized g
write-once locals
PIPELINE II=1 only after addresses are affine
guards: II=4 with a handful of DSP is this bug

skills.pattern: adding PIPELINE/UNROLL/ARRAY_PARTITION on the original nest with no staging or address rewrite
skills.strategy: Reject pragma-only. Rewrite the nest so II=1 is legal.
required_steps: scan for PIPELINE on a loop that still does m_axi RMW — reject
require a real load/compute/store or tiled equivalent
guards: skills are not a checklist of pragmas
skills.template:
// BAD: PIPELINE on the original DRAM RMW nest
// GOOD: stage locals, affine write-once, PIPELINE the proven-independent loop.

skills.pattern: pragma DATAFLOW on a single function body that is still load then compute then store of the same arrays
skills.strategy: DATAFLOW only when INLINE-off tasks have real producer/consumer streams or ping-pong declared inside the DATAFLOW loop. Otherwise LCST is correct.
required_steps: do not emit DATAFLOW unless there are separate tasks
do not treat DATAFLOW as a latency hide by itself
guards: this pack is not the systolic I/O pack
skills.template:
// LCST without DATAFLOW is legal generic HLS.
// DATAFLOW needs INLINE-off tasks + streams, not a pragma on one nest.
